notes: Round 10 runs several tracks at once, each in its own worktree: M1 (land animals), M2 (water mobs), M3 (night mobs) and W's w3 (the game events W's first merge left out). D0's d0b (silverfish in stone, endermites from pearls, flying navigation) is merged (c0366f3a), and release 6 is built with PROTOCOL 11 (789f6d23). Never bump minecraft_net::PROTOCOL: the release step bumps it once when messages changed; if a commit changes a ToClient/ToServer message or the codec, add a line under '## Protocol' in the track log. Insert new match arms and list entries next to related ones, not at the end of lists, to keep merges small (E3-0 names the few positional lists that are appended). Record decisions in the track log. LOAD: builds run at -j 4 per slot to keep the laptop cool; never start a second cargo command, the game, or any other long CPU-heavy process. Keep to the brief: each section names the commit its file:line anchors come from, so re-check every anchor before editing; keep off the hooks the M briefs own and follow the cross-area overlaps (both in E3-0). E2's e2b (44d96765) and D0's d0b (c0366f3a) are merged, so every 'waits for e2b', 'after d0b' and 'release 6 built' in the brief is met; d0b moved lines in server.rs, world.rs, walk_path.rs, entity_view.rs and families.rs, so anchors taken before it need a re-check. The orchestrator brings track-e3 up to minecraft-survival before each segment, so the review uses git diff r10-e3p-base..HEAD as usual. SEGMENT e3p: E3-12: suspicious stews and chorus fruit, Unbreaking and Looting, and name tags. If W's w3 left lead-knot event lines near mob_actions.rs:163-179, keep them.

groups.prompt: Track E3 group food-effects: build track-e3.md section E3-12 group food-effects. Commits: 1. 'Minecraft suspicious stews give their effects when eaten' (potions.rs stew_effects reads minecraft:suspicious_stew_effects, duration 160 by default, amplifier 0; one line in minecraft_survival survival.rs after drink_potion (:1052) applies them through apply_to_player; kinds the player lacks are skipped; player_effect in potions.rs gets a "wither" => EffectKind::Wither row next to "weakness", with a test, since players have Wither but the mapping lacked it; log that custom wither potions now apply too). 2. 'Minecraft chorus fruit teleports the eater like vanilla' (food.rs's true result reaches Bite::Done; actions.rs calls entities.chorus_teleport: up to 16 draws of x/y/z + (nextDouble - 0.5) * 16 from the host's entity random, checked by player lib.rs:1457 try_random_teleport_target whose y range takes the dimension's min and logical height; PlayerOutputs.chorus_landings beside pearl_landings, handled next to render_anim minecraft_players.rs:926 (dismount, teleport, fall cleared, no damage, item.chorus_fruit.teleport, W's Entities::game_event TELEPORT at the old spot, one line); cooldowns.start('minecraft:chorus_fruit', 20) when eating finishes and no bite while it runs; log the 2017 trail as left if level_events.rs can't draw it). Key points: host and friends through the pearl route; if a friend needs a message, note it under ## Protocol; tests as the brief lists; owner steps FE-1 to FE-5 (each stew after /effect give @s minecraft:hunger 5 99, since a suspicious stew needs a hunger bar that is not full) and the kit line.

'Named Minecraft mobs show their name when looked at' (render_anim lists named mobs of the view's EntityWorld (the host's clone at entities.rs:1836-1840, the friend's level.view.world) that are CustomNameVisible or under the crosshair pick, within 64 blocks; MinecraftUi.mob_names next to wither_bars; new hud/src/minecraft_mob_names.rs projects like minecraft_held_map::to_screen and draws the font at 0.025 blocks a pixel on a 0x3F000000 box, white when a block ray reaches the label, 0x20FFFFFF when hidden; ServerMob stays unchanged because it is Copy and on the wire). 3. Key points: names reach friends in the mob tag (MobAdd/MobLook, CustomName not in VOLATILE), so no wire change; Toast, Johnny, jeb_, Dinnerbone and the named wither bar are left; if W's w3 has merged its lead-knot game events near mob_actions.rs:163-179, merge minecraft-survival in first; tests as the brief lists; owner steps NT-1 to NT-7 (single tags renamed one at a time, since the anvil renames a whole stack) and the kit line.
